steps.name: free trade city rivera
steps.objective: Go to "Rivera" and talk to Levy.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You are here. How have you been? I'm glad that nothing seems to have happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy looks healthy too. Since you are here, have you found traces of the enemy?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Please come here for a moment. I think I should speak quietly.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Those believed to be related to the magic stone are hiding somewhere in Rivera.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are they here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then I should give you a brief explanation. Rivera is the largest trading city on the Freios continent.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Like other cities and towns, it is run by citizens rather than nobles and kings. We form a city council and work around the elected mayor.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Perhaps because of this, the atmosphere of the city is more liberal than other places. The composition of buildings and roads is also flexible. A lot of people from different regions come and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it will be familiar to outsiders as well. So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Hmm… , it seems like there is a lot to handle, but you need to prepare for this and that.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Rivera's condition is complicated now, so there will be a lot of work to be done in the future.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'd like you to talk to me again when you're ready.  Oh, in the meantime, I will also be taking care of the backlog.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You're ready. Then let me tell you. The traces of Agashura discovered in Dragon Emperor Castle continue to Rivera through Drullizi in Myrgandia.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Our investigation found traces of them on Marin Island, close to Rivera.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Island? Then I guess I should go there right away.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I can't make a hasty move now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: There are some problems now.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, the Rivera City Hall prohibits entry to the island. They say they can't give permission because there's a civil war going on, but I highly doubt it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: There is definitely something going on inside, but should I say that it seems to be blocking it? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So, after some thought, I found someone who could help me. There are many people in Rivera who are rebelling against the mayor.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don’t know about Adventurer, but they are active under the name of ‘revolutionary army.’

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Is there something strange? A revolutionary army... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The Revolutionary Army also suspects this. They say it doesn't make sense that the city hall is controlling the island, which has traces of unusual creatures.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It is said that this was done to prevent unnecessary accidents, but it is a situation that cannot help but be suspicious in many ways.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So we decided to cooperate with the revolutionary army that rebelled against Mayor Jecal's tyranny.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Just in case, this is a task that His Majesty Giendia has entrusted to me, so you don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? Then, we can proceed with the work with the revolutionary army that rebelled against Rivera City Hall.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Wow, it's complicated just thinking about it. It seems like Agashura, the island, and even Jecal of Rivera City Hall are all connected.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Maybe we'll have to deal with the regular troops guarding Jekal... . Well, think about it later.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, please visit a person named Logia and listen to her story. He is also a member of the revolutionary army... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Since I told you about Adventurer in advance, you will be able to help me right away.

steps.name: The road to Merrin Island
steps.objective: Go to “Merrin Island” and deliver the <Revolutionary Army Token> to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Do you? Ah, this is Adventurer that the inspector of the Gendia Empire mentioned. Welcome to Rivera for Liberty.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Since we have decided to cooperate for each other's work, I should also tell Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: You have been asked to investigate Merrin Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm trying to get there, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Please leave immediately. We have taken steps to ensure that you can go.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Once you enter the island, look for a man named Alvis. If you give me this document and explain the situation, I will help you.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: All of the information coming here now was provided by Alvis, who was there.

steps.name: Rulers of Merrin Island
steps.objective: Defeat the [Red Rabbit Assault] and [Iron Shell Scout] and report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Who are you? A mark of the revolutionary army?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: They said they were sending someone to investigate the island, and it was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. I have come.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: (Alvis, who heard the story from %s, nods.)

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Something like that happened. The strange creatures you met are here too. A twin-headed ogre, a dragon of fire and ice, an armored boar... .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Originally, this was not a place for such creatures.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what… .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I remember them clearly because they are unique guys. I don't know why he showed up, but... .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Those guys definitely showed up and caused damage to the creatures here. I watched with bated breath, but something was strange.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: At one point, it suddenly became quiet, so I wondered where it had disappeared to and found that it had ended up near Drulidge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means there is a place around here where those creatures might be... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know any suspicious locations?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: There are a few suspicious places. However, I couldn't be sure. There are a lot of creatures that hate humans, so it's hard to investigate because we're always interrupted.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: So, I'd like you to drive those guys away first... .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What do you think, would you like to try it?

steps.name: Secure area for search
steps.objective: Defeat the [Red Rabbit Strike Team] and [Iron Shell Attack Team] and report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Very good. You are a skilled Adventurer. I like it because it’s more than I expected.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: But don't think it's easy. There are still many enemies left, so it would be better to use your stamina efficiently.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: First, you need to get their attention. I'll search a little more. I think there's something in the direction I went, but it's not coming out anytime soon.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Please help me a little more. Please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much about this island, so I think it's best to do that for now.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Okay. It's rare to have someone I can communicate well with, so I'm happy about this.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Then I'll come back quickly. Then, until then, divert the attention of those who are trying to interfere.

steps.name: the shocking truth
steps.objective: After defeating [Frogman Warrior], [Deadly Spider Gladiator], [Removal], and [Elian], report to Alvis.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Wow, you look amazing from afar. You can't believe you cornered them like that and bullied them. Ah, not this. Do you know what I discovered?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you discover something?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Yes, I found a suspicious space. But it's a place that seems more terrifying than suspicious.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: There were strange monsters inside, and it seemed like some of them were trying to come out.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: A creature that cannot be seen here, no, a monster. I think that might be the place we were trying to find.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. I'll have to check... . There’s something I want to know… .

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: You have to be careful. It looked really dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: It's noisy outside... . I think someone came... .

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: The Rivera government forces gathered by Jekal couldn't possibly do that, right? It's not like there was any need to cause a fuss.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Van, what do you want to do?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: If it's a distraction, wouldn't it be better to deal with it?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Seeing that it's getting noisier, I don't think it's a baby.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Well, that worked. Let's do a test before we leave here. With our magic stones... .

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Haven't you already collected all the data you need? It's more than what he gave.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: That's enough. There is something a little ambiguous about the magic stone's bird brain ability.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Anyway, let's just watch that and go out. It won't take long.

steps.name: convey the situation
steps.objective: Go to "Rivera" and talk to Levy.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: (Alvis is speechless after checking inside and hearing the story of %s.)

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: A person who was kidnapped and used as material for biological experiments without knowing what was going on, and a water spirit who was brainwashed by the power of a magic stone... . That's terrible.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Mayor Jekal and the city council must have known about the existence of that place. This is really... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need more information... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no way Mayor Rivera, who controls Merrin Island, doesn't know about the existence of that laboratory. I'm sure it's related.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What on earth is the mayor planning?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I thought Mayor Jekal kept doing strange things, but this crossed the line. I'm sure. I think I crossed the line and ended up doing things I shouldn't have done.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: %s, go back and tell the revolutionary army and the person who sent you everything. I'll watch more here.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: … I just hope nothing else happens. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go back. be careful.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I can't believe it's a magic stone laboratory. If something like this had happened on an island that the city had blocked access to, it would definitely be... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Mayor Jekal must have known. First, there are a few things to check.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: If you approach it clumsily, you could end up in trouble... I guess Adventurer has been to the Maseok Laboratory, so he would know about it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: So we need more evidence. Very certain things... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Only then will we be able to find out why Agashura and Mayor Jekal are cooperating.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: First, I will share Rivera's revolutionary army and discuss the direction of progress. In the meantime, Adventurer would like you to gather information about Jekal.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Since Jekal came from a merchant background, I think you can ask Martelly. He has been running the upper level at Rivera for a long time.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: And once this is done, Adventurer will be able to get the information you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . All right.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I hope you don't worry too much. Your Majesty is also working hard to keep your promise.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The Revolutionary Army is aware of Adventurer's activities, so you can leave quietly.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: You're here, I've been waiting for you. I said I had some questions about Jekal, so I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: A lot has happened in the meantime... .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He is the worst kind of person, incompetent and greedy. So much so that no one takes his side... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he that kind of person?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Yes, he is that kind of person. Anyway, I will continue the story. Jekal was born as a descendant of a person called Daesang-in, and grew up with nothing to be envious of.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Then I inherited the top, but it all went bankrupt not long after.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I have poor ears and no skills, but I make a lot of wrong choices and many people around me fall away.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: But that person suddenly became mayor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Is that possible?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Even I have doubts. No one could believe that the person who led the company into bankruptcy through incompetence became mayor.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: People were suspicious of me. People’s behavior has changed drastically at some point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it happened suddenly, wouldn't there have been something?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: First, listen and think. We rebuilt the top and started saving a ton of money. Then, people started to gather together and form a strong force.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: He gave a lot of money to the city council, ran for mayor, and eventually won. Although many people opposed him, the city council pushed him through.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: And began to gather many soldiers in Rivera. Just as I dreamed of becoming a king, I chose dictatorship.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Thanks to this, Rivera is now a mess. At least before he became mayor, even if it was a mess, it wasn't this bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are more than one or two suspicious things.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Moreover, there has been a butler named Deet since some time ago. He is a suspicious person whose origin is unknown. Because Jekal’s behavior changed depending on his opinion.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I told you everything I know. We are working hard to overcome the situation in our own way... .

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Please work hard too. Then I will believe it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: (Levi nods after hearing what he heard from %s.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's just as Martelli said. If a person suddenly changes, there must be something, and let's assume that the reason is Agashura's contract.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know much, but I heard that Agashura's contract is to grant wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I don’t know what the scope of the wish is, but… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Changes in the Jekal market and the magic stone laboratory discovered on Merin Island. And the one who dreams of becoming a king. But does Agashura have the power to change a person like this?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't think it's just that.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It seems like there's something to the magic stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agashura and the magic stone... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I think it will be clear if we find out exactly why the magic stone was created... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m not sure….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wish I could know something more…)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer, I would like to introduce you to Eva, the leader of the revolutionary army.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I think it would be better to talk together.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: This person is the Adventurer that Levy mentioned... . I've heard a lot from you.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thanks to Adventurer's hard work, the revolutionary army was able to get closer to the truth.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: The connection between the Magic Stone Laboratory, Agashura, and Jekal Market... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: We couldn't even figure this out, which was just really frustrating.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: But now, thanks to Adventurer, we can move. In the meantime, we were able to gather a revolutionary army.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you. That's all I can say at this moment... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what are you going to do now? May I tell you my opinion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There seems to be some information in the mayor's official residence, so why not sneak in and look for evidence?

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Yes. Obviously that's the best, but... , Our revolutionary army does not have such skilled personnel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I try it?

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Would you mind?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s has experience solving many problems. He is someone whom our Majesty also trusts.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Of course, I believe it because I saw it in action. You are a great person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment. Then I will try it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you again. I feel sorry for asking Adventurer for everything, but… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: In the meantime, we will help from behind to prevent anything else from happening.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I hope that you will collect any evidence that may be helpful to City Hall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer, please take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Haha, I didn't know it would happen like this. You are good at fighting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I was going to be in big trouble. What are you… .

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: I am a deacon who assists Mayor Jekal. I came forward like this because I thought it would be better for me than to deal with the mayor directly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you like that too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Made like Geminus... .

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It's foolish of you to dare compare that stupid ogre to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Oops, I made a mistake. Well then, I think I know what they did to that stupid ogre.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: You are the one who messed up my master's plans. Hehe, that's fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you planning? Answer me… .

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Hehehe, thanks to you I bought some time.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Thank you for your time.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It's probably not right for me to intervene right now, so I guess I'll have to step down. See you next time then. Of course, if you're still alive before then... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: (As soon as he finishes speaking, Deet disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Where did you go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I got hit.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Was there really just one intruder?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: The entire army that I worked so hard to create was completely wiped out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I got caught... .

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Ugh, how dare you disturb me? I won’t let you go. By the way, how do I tell him… .

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: You still have endless excuses. Mayor.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Butler, you bastard!! Why is it only appearing now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Butler… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's definitely something about that butler.)

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: It was fun to watch. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Right now, I'm not here to fight, so I'll just do my business and go back. Haha

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Jecal Market. Thank you for your hard work so far.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: We did more of the hard work. How much trouble my master and I had to make an incompetent idiot the mayor.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Still, it was worthwhile.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Because I was of great help to the master who took me in.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: And I will accept your next command. I was ordered to dispose of items that had no use value.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Lung, waste? Are you really talking about me?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Me? Come and me now? Are you going to trash me?  How much have I done for you all this time!!

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: I usually didn't want to get into a conversation, but as expected, you're speaking in a shallow way again. Let's get this over with, Mayor Jekal.

lines.speaker: 디트
lines.text: Then, do your best for him. This means forgetting that we are human and showing the end of our desires.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Sigh, damn it... . Ugh, what on earth have you done to me... .

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: I pledged my loyalty... .

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Me like this... Cough! Cough!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Half? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: Hehehe, Agashura. Haha, yes. I didn't believe in Agashura.

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: There is something like Agashura who is fine even after making a wish come true... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, over there... .

lines.speaker: 제칼
lines.text: (I don't think I'll be able to hear anything from Jekal anymore.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agashura… Is Agashura manipulating people like that? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure... . I don't know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the first time Agashura has done something like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris…. Where is Iris…?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Let's go back first. I'd better go back and collect my thoughts... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: (Eva is surprised to hear what happened at City Hall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly Mayor Jekal turned into a monster and I had no choice but to fight.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's okay. Although I was a bit surprised that Jekal had turned out like that, I think it was fortunate that the matter was resolved surprisingly easily.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer's performance saved Lee Rivera.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Adventurer’s skills that I had only heard about were true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. There was a mistake in the middle and I got caught.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should have been a little more careful... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Among the investigators, Adventurer heard this story.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Adventurer is said to be so incredibly strong that the enemy cannot be found in his wake... .

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: I think it's an exaggerated rumor... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Well, isn’t good something good?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you say that, I will take it as a compliment.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then, I will tell you the things that have been organized.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Jekal fell, and the ledgers and records in the city hall were found.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: This is the revolutionary army... , No, now it will be helpful to those who worked hard for Rivera.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you for working hard for us... .

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Even if the help was out of conflict of interest, I will never forget the help you gave me.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: And based on this, I will work hard to become a liveable Rivera again.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Once again, we sincerely thank Adventurer and the Gendia Empire for their help.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I always feel this way, but even after the incident is over, there still seems to be a lot of work to be done.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Adventurer, shall we end this story here?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please give me some time. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: What's the story... . I would like to talk about the Magic Stone Laboratory.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: A person named Alvis discovered traces of suspicious people in the magic stone laboratory, namely those who are presumed to be the Agashura we know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? What is it like?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The place where Adventurer fought a battle with the water spirit... . It is said that a hidden space was discovered nearby.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It looks like all kinds of experiments and research were done there, and it is said to be very terrible.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We plan to collect the traces left there and track them, or are already tracking them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're really fast.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Quick, accurate! That is the belief of the Imperial Investigation Team. Hehehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hearing those words, I look forward to seeing how things will work out in the future.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Of course. You have to look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Levy, to me... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Ah, Logia is looking for Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I don't know about that either. You will find out when you go there.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We will continue to contact you as soon as other information becomes available.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Until then, it would be better to pursue other activities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have no choice, should I just wait?)

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Let me give you some information about the person you are looking for.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: (Logia looks at %s's face and smiles broadly.)

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Mr. Levy first asked us if we knew him. Adventurer said he was looking for his whereabouts... .

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: I wanted to tell you directly. A girl named Iris once came to Rivera. Just for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Please listen calmly. The child said he was trapped somewhere.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: It was a space filled with nothing but sadness, so I wanted to leave quickly, but I couldn't. Then, by chance, I was able to come out... .

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: He was able to come to his senses near Rivera. People like me can’t understand what that means, but… .

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Still, when I later found out what the child named Iris went through, I thought that he must have suffered a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, hey, so where did Iris go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When did that happen?

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: The time has already come to this.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: It's been a year since Iris left here.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: Iris made it a habit to go to where Ceres was. However, I hesitated because it wasn’t the right time.

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: According to legend, I heard that the goddess disappeared to protect the world... . Hmm, maybe he went there to pray?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's there... .

lines.speaker: 로지아
lines.text: There is an old temple south of Freios. A temple where the religious order that believes in the ancient god Ceres resides... . Maybe he went there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Loggia. It was really helpful

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ceres... .  You once told me... . Obviously… . What did you say then? I remember... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. But still, we can't do this here. First, let's go to the temple. You'll find out when you go, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, wait… . I will definitely come find you.
